text:
Noor: quick flag - Nimbus-compact q3 bringup showing locale-specific detok/tokenization glitches across CJK+RTL mixed inputs. Symptoms: stray space(s) before Japanese/Chinese punctuation, ZWJ removal in zh emoji glue, and Arabic closing punctuation being separated. Small repro + logs below. @Yuki @Samir can you take a look?

Yuki: thanks. minimal repro command?

Noor: ran a focused roundtrip eval locally:
```bash
python -m infra.evals.roundtrip \
  --model=nimbus-compact --quant=q3 --n=120 \
  --locales=ja,zh,ar,ko --detok=auto \
  --out=/tmp/nimbus_q3_roundtrip.jsonl
```

Noor: quick examples (detoked strings):
- float baseline ja: "\u3053\u308c\u306f\u6771\u4eac\u3067\u3059\u3002"
- q3 detok: "\u3053\u308c\u306f\u6771\u4eac\u3067\u3059 \u3002"  <-- single extra space before punctuation

- float baseline zh: "\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u6b22\u6068"
- q3 detok: "\ud83d\ude0a \u6b22\u6068"  <-- ZWJ dropped between emoji and CJK char

- float baseline ar: "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645\u060c\u0627\u0644\u0639\u0627\u0644\u0645\u061f"
- q3 detok: "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 \u060c \u0627\u0644\u0639\u0627\u0644\u0645 \u061f"  <-- commas/question-mark spaced out

Samir: hm. do token ids differ between float and q3? that'll tell us tokenizer vs detok step.

Noor: initial quick diff: token ids for ja sample 42 matched at byte-level, but the detok output differed. attaching token-id dump to /tmp/nimbus_q3_ids_sample42.jsonl in the run.

Yuki: that suggests detok normalization divergence (runtime) rather than tokenizer split. did we recently change any detok flags (merge_punct, trim_ws_after_token, norm_zwj)?

Samir: yes - PR #4120 toggled `trim_ws_after_token` default for the new fastpath. float runtime and slowpath got the update but quant fastpath config might still carry the old defaults. iirc quant fastpath was excluded from that config roll.

Noor: repro command forcing legacy detok for comparison:
```bash
python -m infra.evals.roundtrip --model=nimbus-compact --quant=q3 --n=50 \
  --locales=ja,zh,ar --detok=legacy --out=/tmp/nimbus_q3_legacy.jsonl
```

Noor: quick log snippets from the auto run:
```
INFO tokenizer=v2026-03-22 loaded
DEBUG sample[42] locale=ja ids=[345,12,98,77] pre_detok="\u3053\u308c\u306f..." post_detok="\u3053\u308c\u306f\u6771\u4eac \u3002"
DEBUG sample[59] locale=zh ids=[128,900,45] pre_detok="\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u6b22\u6068" post_detok="\ud83d\ude0a \u6b22\u6068"
```

Yuki: interesting - tokenizer version v2026-03-22 is current, so serialization mismatch seems unlikely. leaning strongly on runtime detok flags being out-of-sync. canary-bot, can you start a pinned-run with explicit detok flags and token-dump?

canary-bot: Canary job queued: canary/5123456789-1 (nimbus-compact q3) - 30 samples ja/zh/ar. detok=norm-punct, dump-ids=true. ETA ~9m.

Samir: if canary confirms it's a flag drift, quick mitigation is a routing rule to send ja/zh/ar traffic to float tier while we push a quant image rebuild with synced detok-config. we should keep 10% on quant for telemetry.

Yuki: also add chrF and COMET to the eval (BLEU sensitive to spacing). even if BLEU drops, semantic metrics might be stable.

Noor: initial metric snapshot (120-sample auto run): ja->en BLEU -1.5, zh->en BLEU -0.8, ar->en BLEU -3.2 (subset w/ punctuation-heavy). chrF deltas ~-0.4 to -0.8, COMET shows larger signal for arabic subset.

Samir: action items: 1) canary with detok flags + id dumps (in flight) 2) if confirmed, rebuild quant images copying runtime-config blob from float bake (Samir + infra) 3) pin tokenizer in quant CI to avoid serialization drift (Yuki) 4) add detok golden tests (Noor) 5) consider short routing fallback (EngOps/Product).

Yuki: i'll prepare a tiny golden set with emoji+CJK glue and Arabic punctuation cases. let's add it to the eval harness so future quant brings catch this quickly.

Noor: thanks all - i'll post canary results here when it finishes. pinging @infra if we need expedited image rebuild. :thumbsup:
